mapper.select: SELECT FM.FTA_CODE AS FTA_CODE ,FM.HS_CODE AS HS_CODE ,FR.CTH_RULE AS CTH_RULE ,COALESCE(FR.BU_RULE, 0) AS BU_RULE ,COALESCE(FR.BD_RULE, 0) AS BD_RULE ,COALESCE(FR.NC_RULE, 0) AS NC_RULE ,COALESCE(FR.MC_RULE, 0) AS MC_RULE ,CASE WHEN FTA.INKOTERMS_TYPE = 'EXW' THEN FM.EXWORK_AMOUNT ELSE FM.FOB_AMOUNT END AS INKOTERMS_AMOUNT ,FM.NET_COST_AMOUNT AS NET_COST_AMOUNT ,FM.INAREA_AMOUNT AS INAREA_AMOUNT ,FM.OUTAREA_AMOUNT AS OUTAREA_AMOUNT FROM FCR_MST FM INNER JOIN FTA_MASTER FTA ON FTA.COMPANY_CODE = FM.COMPANY_CODE AND FTA.FTA_CODE = FM.FTA_CODE INNER JOIN FCR_RESULT FR2 ON FM.COMPANY_CODE = FR2.COMPANY_CODE AND FM.DIVISION_CODE = FR2.DIVISION_CODE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FR2.FTA_CODE AND FM.SALES_NO = FR2.SALES_NO AND FM.SALES_SEQ = FR2.SALES_SEQ AND FM.RULE_CONTENTS = FR2.RULE_CODE INNER JOIN FTA_RULE FR ON FR.RULE_ID = FR2.RULE_SEQ WHERE FM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND FM.SALES_NO = #{sales_no} AND FM.SALES_SEQ = #{sales_seq} AND FM.FTA_CODE = #{fta_code} ORDER BY FR2.RULE_SEQ DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT PL.VENDOR_CODE AS VENDOR_CODE ,TO_CHAR(MIN(TO_DATE(PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FROM_DATE ,TO_CHAR(MAX(TO_DATE(PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TO_DATE FROM PO_LEDGER PL WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = FD.COMPANY_CODE AND PL.ITEM_CODE = FD.ITEM_CODE AND PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months', 'YYYYMMDD') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM INNER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD ON ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO AND ECD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE AND ECD.DIVISION_CODE = ECM.DIVISION_CODE AND ECD.VENDOR_CODE = ECM.VENDOR_CODE WHERE ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS = '4' AND ECM.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE AND ECM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND ECD.FTA_CODE = FD.FTA_CODE AND ECD.COO_YN = 'Y' AND ECD.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE AND ((ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'C' AND PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN ECD.APPLY_DATE AND ECD.END_DATE) OR (ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'N' AND PL.WAREHOUSING_NO = ECD.WAREHOUSING_NO AND PL.SEQ = ECD.WAREHOUSING_SEQ))) GROUP BY PL.VENDOR_CODE ) V ON TRUE LEFT JOIN VENDOR VE ON VE.COMPANY_CODE = FD.COMPANY_CODE AND VE.VENDOR_CODE = V.VENDOR_CODE

SELECT FD.ITEM_CODE AS ITEM_CODE ,IM.ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME ,FD.HS_CODE AS HS_CODE ,FD.OUTAREA_AMOUNT AS OUTAREA_AMOUNT ,V.VENDOR_CODE AS VENDOR_CODE ,VE.VENDOR_NAME AS VENDOR_NAME ,V.FROM_DATE AS FROM_DATE ,V.TO_DATE AS TO_DATE FROM FCR_DTL FD INNER JOIN FCR_MST FM ON FM.FTA_CODE = FD.FTA_CODE AND FM.SALES_NO = FD.SALES_NO AND FM.SALES_SEQ = FD.SALES_SEQ AND FM.DIVISION_CODE = FD.DIVISION_CODE AND FM.COMPANY_CODE = FD.COMPANY_CODE LEFT JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = FD.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = FD.ITEM_CODE
WHERE FD.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND FD.SALES_NO = #{sales_no} AND FD.SALES_SEQ = #{sales_seq} AND FD.FTA_CODE = #{fta_code} AND FD.OUTAREA_QTY > 0 AND LEFT(FD.HS_CODE, 4) = LEFT(FM.HS_CODE, 4) ORDER BY FD.OUTAREA_AMOUNT DESC

SELECT FD.ITEM_CODE AS ITEM_CODE ,IM.ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME ,FD.HS_CODE AS HS_CODE ,FD.OUTAREA_AMOUNT AS OUTAREA_AMOUNT ,V.VENDOR_CODE AS VENDOR_CODE ,VE.VENDOR_NAME AS VENDOR_NAME ,V.FROM_DATE AS FROM_DATE ,V.TO_DATE AS TO_DATE FROM FCR_DTL FD LEFT JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = FD.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = FD.ITEM_CODE
WHERE FD.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND FD.SALES_NO = #{sales_no} AND FD.SALES_SEQ = #{sales_seq} AND FD.FTA_CODE = #{fta_code} AND FD.OUTAREA_QTY > 0 ORDER BY FD.OUTAREA_AMOUNT DESC
